theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let size := fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr
    (Set.univ_nonempty : (Set.univ : Set C).Nonempty) : (size '' Set.univ).Nonempty)
  have hfw : 2 * size g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ := by
    unfold fiberwiseClose fiberwiseDistance at h_fw_dist_lt
    rw [← hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt
  have hd : hammingDist f g ≤ size g * 2 ^ steps := by
    let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
    let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
    have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x) ⊆
        Y.toFinset.biUnion (fun y => Finset.univ.image (F y)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hx' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨_, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx'⟩, ?_⟩
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, Finset.mem_univ _,
        (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    refine (Finset.card_le_card hs).trans ?_
    change _ ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    exact Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul Y.toFinset
      (fun y => Finset.univ.image (F y)) (2 ^ steps) (fun y _ =>
        Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq (by simp))
  have ha :
      (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
        BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    simp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hfw)
    rw [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, ha, mul_assoc] at hb
    have hc := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd
    have hp : 0 < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := Nat.succ_pos _
    omega
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact_mod_cast hn

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let P := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    simpa only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] using
      congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_basis, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1]
  have hp (k : Fin 2) :
      P.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
